active_phase.immediate_objective: Implement ONE deterministic UI-conformance detector with one shared contract reader, one shared rule engine, one .dc.html front-end, one js/screens/*.js front-end, machine-readable findings carrying exact path and line, and a complete baseline over the current repository, with NO screen remediation. ARCHITECTURE: scripts/validate-ui-conformance.mjs plus scripts/ui-conformance/{contract,inventory,rules}.mjs and scripts/ui-conformance/frontends/{dc-html,js-screen}.mjs. No helper file beyond the authorized six, so no path-boundary amendment was needed. No new npm dependency; Node 22.22.3 built-ins only. Filesystem traversal is delegated to the existing scripts/ui-foundation/inventory.mjs and token CLASSIFICATION to scripts/ui-foundation/token-parser.mjs via classifyToken, so neither is reimplemented. CONTRACT READER: the closed enums are parsed from the UI_VISUAL_CONTRACT.md section 5 JSON block at run time and never written in detector source. All twelve required keys are validated and the reader fails closed with path and line on invalid JSON, a missing key, a duplicated block or a missing section. The section 5 blob hash f8349e6eeca291fef2edf4d6e30afd628732f00b6495d54eb9273860fa63f1c4 is carried in every report. Canonical token VALUES are resolved from css/tokens.css with cycle guarding, so var(--rv-radius) can be compared against the enum, and --rv-radius-pill's value is read from the token rather than written into the rule. PROVED, NOT ASSERTED: the focused suite rewrites a temporary contract's radius enum and shows the conforming fixture start failing UIC-002 while all six detector files stay byte-identical by SHA-256, and a second test asserts no radius, control_h, shadow or font_size enum value appears anywhere in detector source. INVENTORY: exactly ONE of the 26 archetype rows in UI_CONFORMANCE.md resolves to a tracked file, the Archetype-A reference fixture. The other 25 name screens that live in the external design project and are reported NOT_PRESENT_IN_WORKTREE with their archetype, never silently dropped. Ambiguous duplicate filenames and duplicate rows for one path are refused the same way. The application inventory is all 66 tracked js/screens/*.js. Excluded: node_modules, docs/ui/evidence, docs/ui/fixtures/vendor, tests, services, support.js, the chrome and documentation rows, and the standalone/bundle-ready/print derivative pattern. FRONT-ENDS: the prototype front-end reads inline style AND style-hover attributes AND style rule blocks, tracks the element stack so card membership is a fact rather than a guess, and blanks HTML comments with offsets preserved. The application front-end LEXES, because every visual value sits inside a JavaScript string and a text scan would read values out of comments and regular expressions as readily as out of markup; no npm parser is authorized and Node exposes none, so a narrow hand-written lexer classifies comments, strings, template literals and regex literals and nothing more, decides regex-versus-division by the preceding significant token, and treats an ambiguous / as a HARD FAILURE rather than a guess. NO HARD STOP FOR AN UNAUTHORIZED PARSER WAS REACHED: all 66 files lexed completely, 0 UNSUPPORTED. COVERAGE IS NOT A PASS: severity is blocking, debt or coverage, and they are not interchangeable. FULL means every rule was fully evaluated, not merely that the file parsed. Eight named constructs degrade a file to PARTIAL and each emits an explicit finding, and an UNSUPPORTED file reports zero rules evaluated, never zero defects. ELEVEN RULES, UIC-001 through UIC-011, splitting two conflations the order required: an unresolved token is not a deprecated one, and pill radius on a button is not pill radius on a box. TABLE BOUNDARY RESPECTED: eight tables inventoried, none proven and none failed automatically, all eight MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED including the reference fixture's own three, so no pass was fabricated for the reference. CLI: --report exits 0 even with findings, --enforce exits 1 on a blocking finding, detector or configuration or inventory failure exits 2, and --rule limits enforcement without hiding baseline data. NO WAIVER OR IGNORE-LIST MECHANISM WAS CREATED. DETERMINISM: no network, no clock, no randomness; three consecutive regenerations produced the identical git blob 759139493627752dbd3b7c27dd7589b2bb0e5c45 and a test compares two independent detector processes byte for byte. BASELINE: 67 files scanned, 1 prototype and 66 application; coverage 28 FULL, 39 PARTIAL, 0 UNSUPPORTED; 3971 findings of which 3027 blocking, 323 debt and 621 coverage gaps. UIC-001 2785, UIC-002 97, UIC-003 13 blocking plus 9 gaps, UIC-004 21 blocking plus 21 gaps, UIC-005 80, UIC-006 15, UIC-007 ZERO, UIC-008 0 blocking plus 37 gaps, UIC-009 323 debt, UIC-010 16 blocking plus 2 gaps, UIC-011 ZERO. Native selects 15, cards with a shadow 0, pill-shaped buttons 0, unknown tokens 0, tables requiring manual review 8. The detector's 323 deprecated references and the foundation validator's 335 are different scopes, not a discrepancy. THE REFERENCE FIXTURE IS THE ONLY FILE IN THE REPOSITORY WITH ZERO FINDINGS OF ANY SEVERITY AND FULL COVERAGE. ONE DISCLOSED PRECISION LIMIT, NOT SUPPRESSED: 834 of the 2785 colour findings sit outside any decoded style declaration or colour attribute and carry that context so phase 5 confirms the site first; one is a confirmed false positive, js/screens/cliente-pedido-form.js:206 matching #8431 inside the pt-BR placeholder 'Ex.: Pedido #8431'. It is not suppressed because this phase may not create a waiver mechanism. VALIDATION: focused suite 32/32; tests/ui-foundation-validator.test.mjs 31/31; tests/ui-op-detail-compacto-fixture.test.mjs 36/36; node scripts/validate-ui-foundation.mjs PASS errors=0 debt=335; node --test tests/*.js 4326 tests, 4325 pass / 1 fail, the sole failure the accepted external-corpus tests/g14-c-bridge-smoke.test.js; git diff --check and git diff --cached --check clean. NOTHING WAS REMEDIATED: zero screens changed and css/tokens.css, UI_VISUAL_CONTRACT.md, DESIGN_DECISIONS.md, CODE_HEALTH_RULES.md, every inventoried screen, every fixture source, support.js, the vendor runtime, js/screens, db, index.html and css/responsive.css are byte-identical to ded162e. CONFORMANCE STATE: UI_CONFORMANCE.md is now a mechanical read of the baseline under one stated rule, with the fixture detector-asserted conforming, all 25 unresolved rows labelled UNRESOLVED and unaudited, the two rows previously set by eye corrected to unaudited with their prior observations preserved as prior observations, and a new Application surface section recording all 66 application files as 25 conforming, 38 deviation and 3 unaudited. DISCLOSED PROMINENTLY: all 25 application conforming results are write, data, helper or routing modules that declare NO visual value at all, are conforming by absence, and are not evidence that any screen is canonical. NO ARCHETYPE IS RATIFICATION_ELIGIBLE: ratification needs two screens of one archetype passing the detector, archetype A has exactly one and its candidate second screen is not in this worktree, and archetypes B-F have zero because every candidate fixture is UNRESOLVED. ARCHITECT_BRIEF.md section 3.2's stale sentence claiming archetype A is ratified is corrected; it never was. TWO DEVIATIONS DISCLOSED, NEITHER WORKED AROUND SILENTLY: the #8431 false positive, and the inventory reader bounding an archetype block at the next ARCHETYPE heading rather than at the next ## heading, which this phase's own conformance-state update exposed by doubling the scan to 7942 findings before the section layout was changed; the one-line fix is disclosed and not applied because inventory.mjs shipped in commit 1 and the order authorizes exactly two commits with no amend, and it is mitigated by document layout plus an explicit Editing rule section in UI_CONFORMANCE.md. ONE INHERENT CIRCULARITY, MEASURED NOT ASSUMED: UI_CONFORMANCE.md is both a detector input and a section 13 output, so the baseline committed in commit 1 cannot be byte-identical to a scan of commit 2's tree; all 3971 findings, both inventory counts and every summary are identical and the only delta is the 25 inventory.unresolved line numbers, which are line numbers of the conformance document itself. PHASE 5 NOT STARTED AND NOT AUTHORIZED. The executor does not self-accept and no phase chains automatically.
